external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: Represents the three partners collectively; the text gives no words that distinguish them.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.
external_entities.notes: The source refers to analysts in the plural; no individual distinctions are provided.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that lists and reads files from the landing bucket and triggers a Spark transform job.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in. Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A transform job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket receiving daily partner extracts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted" and says both stores are on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database holding connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest." It also says both stores are on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse store receiving normalized claim records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_stores.notes: Analysts have a dataset-wide grant; member-identifying columns have not been split out.

data_flows.name: drop extracts

data_flows.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us. They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
